description: Fourteen-day blended snow forecast for a resort: per day the median snowfall across the weather models that reach that day (ECMWF IFS, GFS, GEM, ICON, JMA, Météo-France, UKMO; NBM and HRRR added for US points), the 25th/75th percentile band as snowfallLoIn/snowfallHiIn, and modelCount so you can weigh a far-out two-model day against a near-term nine-model one. `summary` has next 48 h, 7- and 14-day totals and the peak day. US resorts also get the National Weather Service text narrative (`periods`), with its snow amounts replaced by the blend. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0): quote the credit. `available: false` when no model run is stored yet.

point.description: Which elevation's blend. Falls back to the other point with a note when the asked one has no runs.

slug.description: PeakCam resort slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `breckenridge` or `ski-portillo`. Get it from search_resorts.

name: get_forecast

license.description: Licence of the source data, e.g. `CC BY 4.0`.

text.description: The attribution line to carry with any reuse, e.g. `Weather data by Open-Meteo.com`.

condition.description: PeakCam icon slug for the weather code (`heavy-snow`, `clear`, ...).

modelCount.description: Models contributing to this day. Falls with lead time as shorter-range models drop out.

models.description: Model ids contributing to this day.

precipProb.description: 0–100, median of the models that publish one.

snowfallIn.description: Median across the models that reach this day, inches.

snowfallLoIn.description: 25th percentile across models, inches. Equals the median when one model reaches the day.

weatherCode.description: Modal WMO code across models; ties go to the more severe code.

forecastUrl.description: The REST document with every model run.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the result was generated.

issuedAt.description: Newest model issue instant among the runs blended.

modelCount.description: Models contributing to the first day.

periods.description: NWS daily narrative for US resorts (up to 5 days); empty elsewhere or when NWS does not answer.

snowInches.description: From the blend when one is stored for that date, else the keyword estimate (see snowSource).

provider.description: `blend`: stored multi-model blend; `nws`: NWS narrative only, snow amounts are keyword estimates; `none`: nothing available.

issuedAt.description: Newest model issue instant among the runs blended.

modelCount.description: Models contributing to the first day.

models.description: Every model id that contributed to any day.

date.description: The day with the most blended snowfall.

windowDays.description: Consecutive days around the peak with at least 1 cm (the storm window).

peak.description: Null when no day has any blended snow.

point.description: The elevation the summary is for: summit when the resort has a summit point, else base.

title: Resort forecast
